provenance.registered: 2026-11-01, before any hipfire baseline exists on this fixture
provenance.rule_text: a_d fails if new < base - max(abs_floor, z*sqrt(var_binom(base,new)), z*sd_rep_base); yield fails if new < base*(1 - max(yield_floor_rel, z*cv_rep_base)); window_ms fails if new > base*(1 + max(window_floor_rel, z*cv_rep_base)); a cell registers only with >= min_reps fresh-process reps and yield cv <= max_cv_register; every depth with reached < min_trials_per_depth is INSUFFICIENT (fails closed); a pass needs every gated cell of every class.

spread_sources.radiance_b1_T1_512tok: mgmtp/parity-mtp/radiance/b1-T1-512tok, 3 reps x 6 cells: yield/user cv 0.000-0.116 (code is high: short outputs), step_ms cv 0.003-0.055 (range up to 0.10 on code-C1), per-depth a_d sd across reps 0.000-0.049
spread_sources.hipfire_pp2_sampled_singleton_l2: r9700x2-par/l2/runs/l2-c1-on{1,2,3}: window-weighted tau sd 0.028-0.113 across 6 categories (range 0.056-0.216), yield cv 0.007-0.028
spread_sources.hipfire_ep2_lanes_fresh_process: epserve/runs e8-bench-on{1,2,3} and g3-bench-on{1,2}: out tok/s range 0.1-3.2% across fresh servers for C1-C4,C8, one 6.0% outlier (C6, n=2); AR step ms (FLOOR kREF1, n=4/3): range 0.4%
spread_sources.reading: z=3 against binomial SE covers within-cell sampling noise; floors cover the smallest observed cv; wider cells register wider tolerances from their own reps, so C1 cells are weak detectors and C8 cells (8x the trials) are the sharp ones
